Entry A status: 'Status: implemented in source behind MODEL_GATEWAY_PLAN_EXECUTE_ON_APPROVE (off); not live-verified. The earlier proposed entry for the same decision stays proposed until its trigger, a live run on the proof stack, is recorded.' Entry A decision: 'DEC-04 (a): the SPA sends one explicit execute turn carrying approved_plan_id. That turn is a new Do run on the same thread and is not in plan mode. session-core ThreadAutonomy.BindGrantToRun binds the thread durable grant to the run server-side, once, and only while the thread still names that plan; the client never supplies a rung. A plan run is read-only, and authority narrows, never widens, for a run in flight. The approval answers continuation execute_now only when the execute switch, the approval-resume switch and the durable grant are all on; otherwise next_message keeps today behaviour. A refusal is the typed plan_grant_unavailable.' Entry A open for owner: 'A durable plan grant still covers every later run on its thread for its 24 h TTL, and the approval response carries the continuation key even with the switch off.' Entry B heading: '## 2026-11-02 - ask_user is a pause kind with its own store, not an approval (WS14-S3 to S5, DEC-05 (b))'. Entry B status: 'Status: implemented in source, dark. Built: the run_questions store and its RPCs, the ask_user tool behind AGENT_ASK_USER_ENABLED (off), and the question card. Not built: the executor input pause and the resume delivery gateway and SPA halves (S5), so AGENT_ASK_USER_RESUME_ENABLED stays off. Not live-verified.' Entry B decision: 'DEC-05 (b): a question is a pause kind of its own, with its own table run_questions, that reuses the pause machinery. It is never a row of approvals: an approval is an authority grant, and an answer must never read as one. One schema, two delivery values: next_turn ships first (the answer is the owner next message), and resume continues the same run through /continue once S5 exists. ZDR and waived runs never get the tool (max_questions is 0, DEC-06 and DEC-32), and the list and answer routes refuse a ZDR caller with 412 zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden. Limits: 3 questions per run, 4 items per call, 6 options per item, 2000 characters, 24 h TTL for next_turn.' Each entry ends with a '---' line and a blank line.
